comment: Files built locally from a verified download, marked generated rather than downloaded. They carry no pinned checksum because the output depends on the macOS sips version; they are rebuilt into ${CLOVE_FIXTURES_DIR}/generated/ when missing and never committed.

recipes.notes: Full-size JPEG rendered from a RAW file, standing in for the in-camera JPEG of a RAW+JPG pair. The camera wrote no JPEG for these files, so the pixels are a system render, not the camera's own JPEG engine.
HEIC rendered from a RAW file, so the HEIC path can be tested without a committed binary.
